paragraphs.text: Sedraxis , also known as the Crumbling Necropolis , is the conquered capital of Vithia on Grixis .

The largest necropolis on the plane, Sedraxis, is filled with gothic arches and cobblestone streets. The once-great city is now a deadly maze of crumbling walls, half-collapsed spires, and roofless shells of buildings. The Lich King Sedris rules this place, though he is usually content to let chaos reign within its walls.
Sedraxis was once the capital city of Vithia, but after being conquered by the dark forces of Grixis , it became a necropolis, and lair of the Lich King Sedris .
